description: Create Year 3 (age 15-16) advanced projects part 1: ai-chatbot, quiz-platform, ai-image-generator, finance-tracker
steps: Create ai-chatbot/ with app.py (main Flask app), chatbot.py (OpenAI integration), templates/index.html, static/style.css, static/script.js. Total 200-300 lines of Python. OOP with ChatBot class, type hints, docstrings, error handling, .env.example (OPENAI_API_KEY), requirements.txt (flask, openai, python-dotenv). Professional README.md with features, setup, screenshots section.

Create quiz-platform/ with app.py, models.py, routes.py (or routes/ package), templates/ (base.html, index.html, quiz.html, results.html, login.html), static/style.css. Total 400-600 lines Python. Flask with SQLite, user sessions, multiple quizzes, scoring, leaderboard. OOP models, type hints, docstrings. requirements.txt (flask, flask-sqlalchemy). Professional README.md.

Create ai-image-generator/ with app.py (150-250 lines). Streamlit UI, DALL-E API integration, prompt input, image display, download button, generation history. OOP, type hints, .env.example (OPENAI_API_KEY), requirements.txt (streamlit, openai, python-dotenv, Pillow). Professional README.md.

Create finance-tracker/ with app.py (main Streamlit app), models.py (data classes), utils.py (helper functions). Total 300-500 lines. Income/expense tracking, categories, charts (plotly), monthly reports, CSV export/import. OOP, type hints, docstrings. requirements.txt (streamlit, plotly, pandas). Professional README.md.
acceptance_criteria: All 4 Year 3 Part 1 project directories exist with complete file structures
Python files use OOP, type hints, and docstrings consistently
All files have valid Python syntax
Each project has .env.example where API keys are needed
README files are professional with: description, features, setup instructions, screenshots section, tech stack
Code is modular (multiple files, separation of concerns)
verification: Run Python syntax check on all Year 3 Part 1 .py files
Verify modular structure (multiple .py files per project)
Verify type hints are present in function signatures
Verify .env.example files exist for API-based projects
Count total lines per project to ensure they match spec
